symptomShortText: Effective induction case depth 1.1mm below minimum 1.8mm drawing specification

defect.defectText: Insufficient case depth after induction hardening

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-1904, Shift C - heat treat operator verified coil alignment and scan speed per setup sheet
High-frequency induction coil EQ-HEAT03-001 internal cooling passage choked with calcium mineral scale, reducing flow to 14 l/min and causing thermal derating of generator power output by 16%
DOC-3390 Rev C - induction scanning speed 4.2 mm/s and quench polymer concentration 12% verified compliant
Forged alloy steel 42CrMo4 chemistry (C 0.41%, Cr 1.05%, Mo 0.22%) and grain size 7 compliant
Microhardness tester GA-0512 optical indentation and calibration verified
Quench polymer tank temperature maintained at 28C +/- 2C

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the drive shaft batch fail destructive metallurgical inspection?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Effective case depth to 50 HRC reached only 1.15mm against the 1.80mm minimum requirement
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Metallurgy lab cross-section hardness report ML-2026-104

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the heat-affected austenitizing zone too shallow?
fiveWhyChain.answer: RF induction power delivered to the shaft surface dropped from 85 kW to 71 kW during the scanning stroke

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did generator power drop during scanning? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: Severe calcium scale inside the induction copper coil reduced cooling flow by 50%, triggering automatic thermal power throttling in the generator inverter
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Maintenance coil descaling and water circuit inspection report

actions.actionText: Quarantine 54 drive shafts from batch B-50604 and perform 100% eddy current non-destructive case depth testing
Acid flush and descale induction coil on WC-HEAT-03; restore cooling water flow to 31 l/min
Convert induction cell cooling to closed-loop deionized water chiller circuit across all heat treat lines

fmeaLink.description: Shallow hardening depth due to induction coil cooling restriction and power throttling

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Eddy current non-destructive testing sorted good parts without scrapping the full batch
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Cooling water quality in heat treatment was connected to open tower with high mineral hardness

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: Drive Shaft S150 induction hardened on WC-HEAT-03 on 2026-08-10
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Shafts hardened on WC-HEAT-01 with demineralized closed-loop cooling system
isIsNot.notes: Defect caused exclusively by coil cooling passage scaling on open-tower circuit
